title: Password Spraying (Active Directory)
description: A single Samba Active Directory Domain Controller for NORTH.SEVENKINGDOMS.LOCAL, no Windows VMs. Account lockout is disabled and a themed roster of domain users is seeded; every password is policy-compliant, but exactly one account (samwell.tarly) reuses a weak seasonal word while the rest are strong and random. Spray a short list of seasonal candidate passwords across the roster, find the single account that authenticates, and use it to read the flag from a share only that account may open.
question: Spray a list of seasonal candidate passwords across the domain user roster, recover the single account that reuses a weak password, and use it to read the flag from the //dc/nightswatch share.
